title: Koala eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- branch -->
  <rect x='5' y='72' width='90' height='8' rx='4' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <rect x='5' y='72' width='90' height='3' rx='2' fill='#A9713F'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='63' rx='20' ry='17' fill='#9FA8B5'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='65' rx='13' ry='12' fill='#C7CED8'/>
  <!-- arms -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='60' rx='6' ry='10' fill='#9FA8B5' transform='rotate(20 33 60)'/>
  <ellipse cx='67' cy='60' rx='6' ry='10' fill='#9FA8B5' transform='rotate(-20 67 60)'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='36' r='21' fill='#AEB7C4'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='19' r='10' fill='#AEB7C4'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='19' r='5' fill='#D9DEE6'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='19' r='10' fill='#AEB7C4'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='19' r='5' fill='#D9DEE6'/>
  <!-- face patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='41' rx='14' ry='11' fill='#D9DEE6'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='33' r='3.2' fill='#3B3F52'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='33' r='3.2' fill='#3B3F52'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='32' r='1.1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='32' r='1.1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='6.5' ry='5' fill='#3B3F52'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='40.5' rx='2' ry='1.4' fill='#7A8090'/>
  <!-- snack: leaf held near mouth -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#5FA85F' transform='rotate(-15 50 54)'/>
  <path d='M42 51 L58 57' stroke='#3E7D3E' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none'/>
  <!-- little paws on leaf -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='51' r='3.5' fill='#C7CED8'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='57' r='3.5' fill='#C7CED8'/>
</svg>
